# Fogu

> Fogu is a scripting language (`.fg` files) with errors as values, optional
> runtime-checked type annotations, cooperative concurrency (`fg`, `chan`,
> `select`) and a large standard library (`fogu:*`: files, HTTP/web, SQL, Redis,
> queues, LLMs, CLI tools…). One binary, `fogu`, runs, checks, tests, formats and
> compiles programs to standalone executables for Linux, Windows, macOS and
> Raspberry Pi.

Fogu looks like JavaScript/Go but is neither: there is no `var`, no
`try`/`catch`, no spread, and `int / int` is integer division. Read the agent
guide before writing Fogu code, and check code with `fogu check file.fg`.

## Docs for agents

- [Agent guide (skill)](skills/fogu/SKILL.md): rules, syntax, errors, concurrency, workflow, common mistakes
- [Standard library](skills/fogu/stdlib.md): every `fogu:*` function with its signature and a tested example

## Docs for people

- [README](README.md): overview, language tour, CLI, packages
- [CLI](docs/cli.md): every command and option
- [Packages](docs/packages.md): fogu.json, git dependencies, fogu.lock
- [Specification](docs/spec.md): the language design (partly aspirational; see CHECKLIST.md)
